$comment: Global OPNsense aliases shared across TAPPaaS modules. Referenced from module.json via 'alias:<name>'. Module-local aliases (module.json -> aliases) override entries here; collisions are warned.

private_ranges.description: RFC1918 private IPv4 ranges (10/8, 172.16/12, 192.168/16). Not usable as a module rule peer: it spans every zone, so the zone policy cannot be checked and rules-manager refuses it — name the zone or module instead.

public_dns.description: Public DNS resolvers (Quad9, Cloudflare), for a module that resolves directly rather than through the firewall. Counts as the internet in the zone policy.
